# The drying shed

- K4 [text](sources/kiln-night.md) The drying shed is a shed that stands beside the kiln-yard.

origin: source sources/kiln-night.md

- K5 [text](sources/kiln-night.md) The drying shed has no lamp.
- K6 [text](sources/kiln-night.md) The door of the drying shed faces the kiln-yard.
